71    /**
72     * Generates a NIR / Sécurité Sociale number (13 digits + 2 digits for the key)
73     *
74     * @see https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Num%C3%A9ro_de_s%C3%A9curit%C3%A9_sociale_en_France
75     *
76     * @return string
77     */
78    public function nir($gender = null, $formatted = false)
79    {
80        // Gender
81        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
82            $nir = 1;
83        } elseif ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
84            $nir = 2;
85        } else {
86            $nir = $this->numberBetween(1, 2);
87        }
88
89        $nir .=
90            // Year of birth (aa)
91            $this->numerify('##') .
92            // Mont of birth (mm)
93            sprintf('%02d', $this->numberBetween(1, 12));
94
95        // Department
96        $department = key(Address::department());
97        $nir .= $department;
98
99        // Town number, depends on department length
100        if (strlen($department) === 2) {
101            $nir .= $this->numerify('###');
102        } elseif (strlen($department) === 3) {
103            $nir .= $this->numerify('##');
104        }
105
106        // Born number (depending of town and month of birth)
107        $nir .= $this->numerify('###');
108
109        /**
110         * The key for a given NIR is `97 - 97 % NIR`
111         * NIR has to be an integer, so we have to do a little replacment
112         * for departments 2A and 2B
113         */
114        if ($department === '2A') {
115            $nirInteger = str_replace('2A', '19', $nir);
116        } elseif ($department === '2B') {
117            $nirInteger = str_replace('2B', '18', $nir);
118        } else {
119            $nirInteger = $nir;
120        }
121        $nir .= sprintf('%02d', 97 - $nirInteger % 97);
122
123        // Format is x xx xx xx xxx xxx xx
124        if ($formatted) {
125            $nir = substr($nir, 0, 1) . ' ' . substr($nir, 1, 2) . ' ' . substr($nir, 3, 2) . ' ' . substr($nir, 5, 2) . ' ' . substr($nir, 7, 3) . ' ' . substr($nir, 10, 3) . ' ' . substr($nir, 13, 2);
126        }
127
128        return $nir;
129    }
